concerns.text: FR-001 requires loading composition‑Tg pairs from the cited Zenodo datasets (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.10043838 or fallback DOI 10.5281/zenodo.11023456). The plan replaces this with synthetic data generation (see `code/generate_synthetic.py`). This deviates from the functional requirement and leaves the FR unaddressed.

FR-008 specifies applying a False Discovery Rate (Benjamini‑Hochberg) correction at α ≤ 0.05 for predictor‑pair correlation tests. The plan instead states a Bonferroni correction (see FR‑008 entry in the FR/SC Coverage Map). The required correction method is not implemented, so the FR is not satisfied.
